content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

The Sovereign Stack, powered by NOWPayments, is a base-layer infrastructure solution for digital creators, providing automatic crypto payment verification, instant product delivery, and full data ownership without relying on Stripe or other major payment gateways. By owning their infrastructure, creators can avoid platform fees, maintain control over their data, and scale their businesses without restrictions. This shift from renting to owning infrastructure is crucial for creators in regions where major payment gateways are restricted.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind the Sovereign Stack involves a combination of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments provides automatic crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee and support for 300+ cryptocurrencies. This architecture enables creators to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack that is secure, scalable, and cost-effective.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
The Sovereign Stack offers a 0.5% fee compared to Gumroad's 10% charge.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Complete Builder Kit, offering six blueprints and seven templates, is the ultimate resource for creators looking to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack. With NOWPayments as the payment gateway, creators can enjoy a 0.5% fee, compared to Gumroad's 10%, and access to 300+ cryptocurrencies. The Kit provides everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Google Apps Script, Supabase, Google Sheets, Google Drive, and Cloudflare R2.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, follow these steps: create a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site, set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, configure Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Then, integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification and enjoy the benefits of a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
The Complete Builder Kit is the ultimate resource for creators looking to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell ebooks, courses, or digital downloads without relying on Gumroad or Payhip, or want to explore other options for selling digital products without platform fees, the Sovereign Stack and Complete Builder Kit offer a comprehensive solution. You can purchase the Complete Builder Kit for $197, which includes all six blueprints and seven templates, or shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is the fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments?
At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921, thanks to NOWPayments' 0.5% fee compared to Gumroad's 10% charge.
Can I use the Sovereign Stack with other payment gateways?
No, the Sovereign Stack is specifically designed to work with NOWPayments, providing automatic crypto payment verification and support for 300+ cryptocurrencies.
How do I know if the Sovereign Stack is right for me?

If you're a digital creator operating in a region with restricted or limited major payment gateways, the Sovereign Stack is an ideal solution for you, offering a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure and automatic crypto payment verification.
What happens if I need to scale my business?

The Sovereign Stack is designed to be scalable, with NOWPayments providing automatic crypto payment verification and support for 300+ cryptocurrencies, making it easy to handle increased sales volumes and business growth.
Can I use the Sovereign Stack with other digital products?
Yes, the Sovereign Stack is versatile and can be used with a wide range of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software.
